config.script:
userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.deleteWidgetParameter(self.view.custom.dashboardWidgetParamInfo.dashboardWidgetParameterId, userId)
	if msg:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', msg)
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Dashboard Widget parameter has been cleared')		
		self.view.params.value.dashboardWidgetParameterId = None
		
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.dashboardWidgetParamInfo")
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshDashboardWidgetParams', {'dashboardWidgetId':self.params.value.dashboardWidgetId})
	
	return

onChange.script:
system.perspective.print("widgetParameterInfo change %s"%origin)
	
	if origin != 'BindingWriteback': return
	
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	dashboardWidgetParamInfo = self.custom.dashboardWidgetParamInfo
	
	dashboardWidgetParameterId = dashboardWidgetParamInfo['dashboardWidgetParameterId']
	system.perspective.print('dashboardWidgetParameterId is %s'%dashboardWidgetParameterId)
	if dashboardWidgetParameterId is None: 
		system.perspective.print('addWidgetParameter')
		dashboardWidgetParameterId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addWidgetParameter(dashboardWidgetParamInfo, userId)
		self.params.value.dashboardWidgetParameterId = dashboardWidgetParameterId
	else: 
		system.perspective.print('updateWidgetParameter')
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateWidgetParameter(dashboardWidgetParamInfo, userId)
		self.refreshBinding("custom.dashboardWidgetParamInfo")
		
	if msg:	system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', msg)
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Dashbord widget parameter has been saved')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshDashboardWidgetParams', {'dashboardWidgetId':self.params.value.dashboardWidgetId})
	
	return

transforms.code:
paramInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.dashboard.getWidgetParameters({'widgetParameterId': value['widgetParameterId'], 'dashboardWidgetParameterId': value['dashboardWidgetParameterId']}),0)
	
	if paramInfo['widgetParameterName'] is None: paramInfo['widgetParameterName'] = ''
	if paramInfo['defaultValue'] is None: paramInfo['defaultValue'] = ''
	if paramInfo['value'] is None: paramInfo['value'] = paramInfo['defaultValue']
	if paramInfo['enabled'] is None: paramInfo['enabled'] = False
	paramInfo['dashboardWidgetId'] = self.params.value.dashboardWidgetId
	
	return paramInfo
